lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near-perpendicular angles, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A dense collection of high-luminance blobs of varying diameters is distributed across the entire visible surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) are visible attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fins.
